text: Professional Overview: The Digital Economy major mainly studies the operational laws of the digital economy, measures its scale, promotes the industrialization of digital technology and the digitalization of industries, and achieves the deep integration of digital technology with industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, and services.Training Objectives: To cultivate high-quality specialized talents in economics who possess good ideological and moral qualities and self-cultivation, consciously practice the core socialist values, have a solid foundation in the basic knowledge and theories of economics-related majors, master the basic methods of modern economics, are familiar with China's economic operation and reform practices, and have an international perspective and the ability to innovate and start businesses.Curriculum Design: The curriculum system consists of two parts: theoretical teaching and practical teaching. Theoretical teaching includes ideological and political theory courses, general education courses, professional basic courses, professional courses, and any elective courses. Practical teaching includes professional experiments and training (including employment guidance), professional internships, social practices (including innovation and entrepreneurship practices), and graduation theses.Further study directions: Some graduates can enter "Double First-Class" construction universities or key institutions of major categories to pursue a master's degree through direct recommendation or examination.Employment directions: After graduation, students can work in various levels of national administrative departments, industrial and commercial enterprises, financial institutions, research units and digital industry departments related to the digital economy, engaging in data analysis, industrial digitalization construction and other work. One can also work in emerging fields such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, robotics, and e-commerce, engaging in economic analysis, financial analysis, and industry management. Additionally, one can enter civil service positions in the Ministry of Commerce, the State Administration for Market Regulation, and Hangzhou Customs.
